signals.evidence: Emergency feature (Epic 62) renders user-facing UI text that never routes through react-i18next, despite the page importing useTranslation and localizing everything else. (1) EmergencyContactsList.tsx:30-31 hardcodes the empty-state copy 'No emergency contacts found.' / 'Add your first emergency contact to get started.' as raw literals — an empty-state exists but its text is English-only. (2) The contact-type dropdown in EmergencyContactDirectoryPage.tsx:216-221 and the group headings in EmergencyContactsList.tsx:87 render CONTACT_TYPE_LABELS values ('Fire Department', 'Police', 'Ambulance', ...) directly as visible labels. App ships sk/cs/de/en; cs/de/en/sk users see these strings in English. Fix: wrap the empty-state copy in t() and map contact types to i18n keys instead of the English label map.

Systemic i18n completeness gap: 67 of 196 *Page.tsx / *List.tsx files under frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features have NO useTranslation import at all — entire feature surfaces are hardcoded English despite the app's sk/cs/de/en requirement. Whole pages affected include community (FeedPage, EventsPage, GroupsPage, GroupDetailPage, CreateGroupPage), workflow-automation (AutomationRulesPage), marketplace (QuoteComparisonPage), financial (FinancialDashboardPage, InvoiceList/OverdueInvoicesList/RecentPaymentsList), buildings (BuildingsPage, BuildingDetailPage, BuildingList), announcements (AnnouncementsPage, Create/EditAnnouncementPage), forms (Available/CreateFormPage, FormList, SubmissionList) and the error pages (NotFound/Forbidden/ServerError/SessionExpired). This is broader than scattered toast literals (see 2026-09-03 pass) — these components localize nothing. Recommend a tracked i18n-backfill sweep, prioritizing high-traffic pages (community feed, financial dashboard, buildings) and the error pages. Grep to reproduce: for each features/**/*Page.tsx|*List.tsx, flag files where `grep -q useTranslation` fails.

Anti-pattern: user-facing display labels are defined as a hardcoded English string map (CONTACT_TYPE_LABELS) inside the @ppt/api-client package at frontend/packages/api-client/src/emergency/types.ts:77-87, then consumed as visible UI text by ppt-web (EmergencyContactDirectoryPage / EmergencyContactsList). This couples presentation copy to the API-client/transport layer, makes the labels unreachable by react-i18next, and means any i18n fix for the emergency feature (finding code-review-ppt-web-ui-emergency-untranslated-ui) must first move these labels out of the shared client. Recommend the client export only the ContactType enum/values and let ppt-web resolve display strings via its i18n catalog (emergency.contactType.<value>).
